integrity: The proof classifies all length-two lineups from additive row-plus-column scores, computes one common vertex norm and the exact row-column barycenter, and proves minimum-enclosing optimality and uniqueness through an explicit positive equal-weight contact certificate. Finite exact-arithmetic checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to lineup length two, products of two standard simplices with at least two vertices in each factor, and the native orthogonal coordinate metric. It does not assert cosphericity for longer lineup lengths, affine images, inradii, John ellipsoids, or full distance spectra. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent additive-tableau observation under different terminology.
title: Two-lineup products of two simplices have an exact all-vertex minimum sphere
